message: Important Notice Version 1.0.6 Beta 2 introduces an experimental data storage framework. Please proceed with caution when updating, as there is a risk of losing Easy Login specific data.
Beta 4 is out The Easy Login 1.0.6 beta is entering its final stages. Please update to 1.0.6 Beta 4.
Feedback wanted Please provide any feedback you might have via email, Discord, or the GitHub page.

There will be a <color=yellow>Beta 5</color> release in a few days.
Please use the new self-update functionality, introducted in <color=yellow>Beta 4</color>, located in the settings menu to update when the time comes.
